description: GRU no-ReLU-wrap behavioral controls for seeds 6-9, migrated from pending Amarel elements to DSW 5000.

dependency_strategy.smoke: waived by explicit human instruction; completed Amarel seeds 1-5 validate the identical protocol
dependency_strategy.task_map: tasks 10-13 -> gru_nowrap seeds 6-9; tasks 10-11 on GPU2 and tasks 12-13 on GPU3
dependency_strategy.amarel_handoff: 61753234_10-13 cancelled only after all four DSW writers entered epoch 1

notes: Protocol: gru_nowrap h105, lr=0.005, wd=0.001, cnn dropout 0.0, recurrent dropout 0.5, AdamW, 40h-uint8, sequence length 32, 150 epochs, checkpoint every 5 epochs, automatic resume.
Each H20 runs two writers. At the epoch-1 handoff check, GPU2 and GPU3 each used 77,786 MiB of 97,871 MiB with no logged error.

The DSW source snapshot predates AIM3_SEED_OFFSET support. A run-root execution copy adds only seed-offset and output-leaf environment overrides; its SHA-256 is d7b23c9bbeab28ff9301693f968e5585a35ea597a8af7cecec17e87e0d2b2ee3. The wrapper SHA-256 is d3e6c87ff177b03362b7052c8e35639e571d2e44780614c555195cf6d60331ed.

An initial attempt exposed the old snapshot mismatch and started seeds 1-4. It was interrupted during epoch 1 before the migration gate, its evidence was retained, and no Amarel element was cancelled for that attempt.
The corrected writers were verified at Epoch 1/150 with result suffixes seed06 through seed09 before Amarel elements 61753234_10-13 were cancelled.
